exam: TNPSC Group II / IIA · 2025 General Studies and Aptitude
scope: Q101–113 of printed Q101–200. Mirror PDF pages 1–12 correspond to printed booklet pages 43–54, CCSE2-2AT/2025 (Tamil variant). Editorial English adaptations, not bilingual verbatim. questionCandidates.text: Which epoch/period combination does the specimen offer for the emergence of modern humans?
issues: Visually reviewed mirrored CCSE2-2AT/2025 specimen scan page 1, printed page 43. Editorial adaptation, not verbatim; tentative key only; ungraded.
Expert committee referral; no tentative tick. Modern Homo sapiens emerged in the Pleistocene (Quaternary), absent from these choices.

Tear gas is a broad category; the particular compound in the question is chloropicrin.

questionCandidates.text: Under the historical racial classification used in the exam, assess claims about the so-called Nordics: 1 Indo-Aryans were the final immigrant group; 2 they immediately followed the Negritos; 3 arrival was dated to 2000–1500 BCE.
issues: Visually reviewed mirrored CCSE2-2AT/2025 specimen scan page 4, printed page 46. Editorial adaptation, not verbatim; tentative key only; ungraded.
